units.source_text: 二条院的紫姬自别源氏公子以来，岁月悠悠，没有片刻释念的时候。

en.t: Since parting from Prince Genji, Lady Murasaki of the Nijo estate had passed the long months and years without a single moment when she could set her thoughts of him aside.

units.source_text: 东殿里的侍女都已转到西殿来侍候紫姬。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting from the eastern wing had all moved to the western wing to serve Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 她们初来的时候，觉得这位夫人并无何等优越之处，

en.t: When they first arrived, they felt that this lady had no particular superiority about her,

units.source_text: 后来渐渐熟悉，方知此人容貌态度，亲切可爱，

en.t: but as they gradually came to know her, they realized that her appearance and manner were warm and charming,

units.source_text: 待人接物，诚恳周到，便没有一个人想告退了。

en.t: and that she treated everyone with such sincerity and care that not one of them wished to leave her service.

units.source_text: 身份较高的侍女，紫姬有时也和她们晤面。

en.t: Lady Murasaki would sometimes meet in person with the ladies-in-waiting of higher rank.

units.source_text: 她们都想：“诸人之中，公子特别宠爱这位夫人，确有道理。”

en.t: They all thought, "Among all the women, there is indeed good reason why the Prince especially loves this lady."
